USUNCL.TTF.maker: QualiType (1992; released under open licenses with John Colletti permission)
USUNCL.TTF.note: Rights cleared through the official CTAN QualiType collection. CTAN says the 45 fonts were created by QualiType and released with John Colletti’s permission. The archive includes QTUSA-Uncial.otf with matching internal family and exact 1992 copyright; its COPYING-QUALITYPE file licenses the collection under SIL OFL 1.1 or GNU GPL 2.0+ with a font exception. The staged file is the same titled QualiType TTF from 1992 (different format/glyph count from the OTF); OFL defines format changes as modified versions. Redistribution/use must follow the chosen license: retain copyright and license, do not sell the font by itself, and follow OFL naming rules for derivatives. The package maintainer contact was reached in the archive README.
